agent.runner_summary: Runs the AgentScience prompt wrapper through the simulator adapter, which builds the default agent prompt and executes one raw string task with agentscience_agent.run_agent().

log_notes: Adapter metadata includes num_turns, hit_unknown_subcommand, and agent_transcript from the underlying headless Claude run.
The simulator forces AGENTSCIENCE_BASE_URL to a localhost sandbox and uses a throwaway token so platform auth checks stay local and publish-style routes fail closed.
learning_env_guidance: Agent environments should pass a raw string in FixedTurn.content. Do not wrap the task in JSON or another helper object.
Prefer read-only repo inspection or local CLI validation tasks. The underlying agent can invoke Bash, Read, Glob, Grep, Write, and Edit from the repo root.
When scenario stability matters, pin AGENT_MODEL, AGENT_MAX_TURNS, and AGENT_TIMEOUT_S through runtime env configuration.
